sections.Profile:
The "Hollywood Heat" pinball machine, released by Gottlieb in June 1986, features a distinctive 1980s theme inspired by the "Miami Vice" TV show. Designed by John Trudeau with artwork by Larry Day and Don Marshall, this game showcases vibrant and colorful graphics, capturing the South Florida aesthetic.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1986
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
